text: Frontal chest radiograph. The lungs are clear without focal consolidation, effusion, or pneumothorax. The cardiomediastinal silhouette is normal. No acute cardiopulmonary abnormality.
Frontal chest radiograph. There is a focal airspace opacity in the lung consistent with lobar pneumonia. No large pleural effusion or pneumothorax.
Frontal chest radiograph. There is blunting of the costophrenic angle with a layering pleural effusion. No pneumothorax.
Posteroanterior chest radiograph. Patchy airspace consolidation is present consistent with pneumonia. The cardiac silhouette is within normal limits.
